notes.title: We are Working on Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello Community!

We know you have been waiting patiently since our first big update that doubled the usability of this software. We also have a lot going on for the next big update.. but it takes time for us small studios (if you can call 2 guys with day jobs a studio lol).

We just want to make it an official announcement that we are working on adding more..we can't wait to share more news about it.. and no there is no date set yet.. when it's done.. it's done.


[h1]Thank you for being a part of the Printer Forge 3D Community![/h1]

Fantasy Miniature Maker Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811672/15c2eb2eb7fe714e036daae07ddff26ff0d42777.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Fantasy Miniature Maker Update is Here![/h1]

Welcome to the next evolutionary step from Printer Forge 3D. We have split the software up into multiple building areas. Adding the much anticipated Fantasy Miniature Maker Area.

Build your custom fantasy heroes and 3D print them, as many as you like! You don't even need a 3D printer to enjoy this software. You can get your creations printed online and shipped to you.

[list]
[*]23 initial main characters
[*]Over 150 Add-ons
[*]Over 40 animation
[*]A robust animation control and pose system
[*]Multiple Base options
[*]Export to STL file
[*]Tons of content and animations still to be added!
[/list]

[i]** Watch the new video on the Steam Store page gor more information![/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811672/03b9dafd3f17bca1582eefa960586ff53438211b.png[/img]

notes.title: Fantasy Mini Maker on update, before Xmas!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811672/5484f33a367842da151b0c9daadca4e17790dd1e.jpg[/img]

Unlike the free build area used for the mechs and starships we have built a node connection system for the Fantasy Miniature Maker update. 

[list]
[*]Choose a base mini and add on items and weapons. 
[*]Use the animation chooser to pick an animation.
[*]Control the speed of the animation and pause it in the exact pose you want.
[*]Choose a base for your mini, if any.
[*]Export your mini to an STL file.
[*]Print your mini on your 3D printer or order a print online to be shipped to you.
[/list]

[i]We are working to have the Printer Forge Early Access patch 1.5 out before Xmas so that your stockings can be overflowing with Fantasdy Minis![/i]
